data.action: 坐课桌半褪成年礼服沾奶油
data.description: 黄昏空无一人的私人工作室里，课桌上摆着吃了一半的鲜奶蛋糕。和纱双腿并拢坐在桌沿，成年礼服制服半褪露出雪白柔嫩的香肩，指尖还沾着一抹晶莹的奶油。她脸颊滚烫地望向你，小声诱惑道——「……吃不完的话太浪费了。老师……你要直接尝尝我手上的奶油……还是，尝尝别的？」
data.promptProse: Adult Kazusa sits at the edge of the studio worktable with her knees together, her white blouse slipped from one shoulder above the gray plaid skirt. She holds up the fingertip marked with cream toward the viewer; the half-eaten cake rests beside her in the mixed dusk and room light.
data.title: 杏山和纱 · 空私人工作室的私密甜点品尝
data.animaCaption: She holds the cream-marked fingertip toward the viewer beside the half-eaten cake.
